title: Strategy Lab
description: Each strategy is fitted on the first 10 months of the trailing year and validated on the last 2 months. Only out-of-sample (test) results drive strategy selection.

errors.evaluationFailed: Evaluation failed — load price history first (Universe page / data loader)

momentum.explanation: Momentum strategies buy assets that have been rising and sell those that have been falling, betting that recent trends tend to continue over the short to medium term.

mean_reversion.explanation: Mean-reversion strategies assume prices swing back toward their historical average over time, so they buy assets that have fallen sharply and sell once they recover.

trend_following.explanation: Trend-following strategies enter in the direction of an established price trend and exit once that trend breaks down, aiming to ride sustained moves.

balanced.explanation: A balanced blend combines trend and momentum signals with gentler thresholds, aiming for steadier, lower-volatility entries and exits.

detail.noTrades: No trades in the test window.
